fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Graves''' fires a smoke canister at the target location that upon impact deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 50% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
fields.description2: The canister creates a cloud of smoke for 4 seconds that applies {{tip|nearsight}} of outside the area to all enemies within every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, reducing their {{tip|sight}} radius relative to the center.

dataPolicy.blockedDataPolicy: DDragon is provenance at most, NEVER current numeric truth. A mechanism may remain blocked_data only when the checked League Wiki template itself lacks or marks unknown the required numeric contract.
